name: Enamel Panic!!
source:
Main character is a reincarnation of a legendary hero. He has no choice but to save a different world by collecting crystals, rescuing damsels in distress and defeating the demon king.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是传说中英雄的转世。他别无选择，只能收集水晶、拯救身陷困境的少女并击败魔王，从而拯救异世界。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
